name: Air Quality Data for Health-Related Applications
short_name: Air Quality Data for Health-Related Applications
description: Spatial aggregations of datasets from the Air Quality Data for Health-Related Applications. Aggregations of surface daily estimates available for NO2, O3, and PM25 for the contiguous US for the period of 2000-2016.
